start.text: Odda Venn. Graymoor Hold is the last dry yard before the fields forget how to be fields. The boars are the first problem. Eight of them.

south.text: South is Valdoria, and Blackpine Tower, where Osric still pretends a kingdom can be kept with one yard. North is Hoffender, if you miss the snow. The grass track to the east only comes back to the wilds. It does not skip this hold.

boars_active.text: Eight field boars. They like the fences. The fences do not like them back.

boars_ready.text: Eight. The mud will grow more. Next is Hask. He used to collect for me. Now he collects for the band on the south road, and he does not stay down.

after_boars.text: Hask the Reeve. South of the pond, with the bandits who still call him by the old title. End it.

hask_active.text: Hask is not a common bandit. If you leave him, the collection starts again before the mud dries.

hask_ready.text: The title is quiet. It will not stay quiet forever. That is the work, down here.

done.text: The hold stands. Sit if you need the yard. The charts are Thornhaven and the hold, not the whole south.

start.text: Nell Ash. I walk the fences Odda worries about. The boars are hers to count. If you are going south, do not take the pines for a garden. Valdoria starts when the mud gives up.
Osric Blackpine. The tower is the kingdom's, which these days means it is mine to keep standing. Brigands on the road are the count I can still make. Six of them.

south.text: South, the Eldenweald, and Eldenmoor in tiers beyond the trees. High elves. Queen Ellewynn XVI keeps the castle and does not keep the woods. North is Thornhaven, then snow.

road_active.text: Six road brigands. Stay on the road if you want them. They do not come into the yard.

road_ready.text: Six. The road will fill in. The one who will not fill in quickly is Captain Malrek, east of the tower, by the water.

after_road.text: Captain Malrek. He camps where the pines meet the water and calls that a command. I want the command ended.

malrek_active.text: Malrek does not come back with the common brigands. That is why he has the name.

malrek_ready.text: The pines are not his. They were never his. Take the quiet while it lasts.

done.text: The yard is yours if you bind here. The charts stop at the kingdom. Eldenmoor sells its own ink.

start.text: Liriel Dawn. The Silver Stair. The beds are quiet and the fire does not ask which gate you came through. If you fall in the Eldenweald, and you have not bound somewhere else, you can wake in my yard.

choices.label: What if I am new here?

new.text: Sere has the north gate. The wolves are the first work. Halden stands in the castle court if the queen's house has a word. Maeriel, in the White Pages, teaches what a wizard is allowed to buy. Nothing teaches itself.

start.text: Maeriel Voss. The White Pages. A spell is a page you pay for, and it will not open until you are old enough for it. The list says the level. I do not skip lines.

who.text: High elves. Ingrid Mire keeps a hall in Hoffender for the day one of us walks that far. A barbarian still may not. The cold they carry is not this cold.

start.text: Tael Linden. Rations, bandages, and the two charts I am allowed to sell: Eldenmoor, and the Eldenweald. Valdoria is Osric's ink. I do not draw the snow.
Sere Alder. The north gate. Weald wolves have been counting the wall the way I count them. Eight.

out.text: Hares and foxes by the wall. Wolves after that. Poachers where the trees thicken, and the Amber Hart if the wood feels like showing it. The road north leaves the weald for Valdoria. That road is not a first walk.

wolves_active.text: Eight weald wolves. They stay outside the wall if the gate is doing its work.

wolves_ready.text: Eight. The gate can breathe. Lark the Poacher is the next name. North, where the bandits think the hart is a purse.

after_wolves.text: Lark the Poacher. Not a wolf, and not the hart. The person selling what the hart walks past.

lark_active.text: Lark keeps to the north trees. Come back when the poaching stops.

lark_ready.text: The north is quieter. The hart is Halden's to ask about, not mine. I keep the gate.

done.text: The gate holds. If you go north out of the weald, go fed. Valdoria does not feed beginners.

start.text: Halden Cour, steward to Her Majesty Queen Ellewynn XVI. The queen does not stand in the yard. I do. The Amber Hart has been seen in the deep of the Eldenweald. She would like it discouraged, not mounted.

queen.text: Eldenmoor is built in rings. Travelers outside the wall. Trades in the first ring. The city in the second. The castle is hers. The woods are not a ring. They are a road that eventually remembers snow.

hart_active.text: The hart is not a pet and not a daily sight. If you do not find it, walk the north trees and wait. It comes back slower than a wolf.

hart_ready.text: You found it. Her Majesty will hear that the wood was asked, and that it answered. That is the whole of the errand.

done.text: The court is quiet. If you are a wizard, Maeriel has the pages. If you are walking north, the kingdom of Valdoria is the next true road, and it is not kind to the unready.

start.text: Anwen Pell. I came down the mouth looking for my brother and found a fire that was easier to keep than the way back. If Kara sent you, the crawlers are the first count. If she did not, go and let her name it.

under.text: The Shatter Gallery, then the vault. Magister Calden walks the gallery. Ysolde of the Black Ice keeps the vault. The thing on Rimeheart Lake wears her name and is not her. Vargan, up in the cleft, is not hers either.

mouth_active.text: Eight rime crawlers. They are the small cold. Count them, then come back to the fire.

mouth_ready.text: Eight. The mouth can be walked. The gallery is the next stair, and Calden is the reason it is not a hallway.

offer_gallery.text: Magister Calden. The middle of the Shatter Gallery. He stays down longer than the guards. I want that gap to start with you.

gallery_active.text: Calden. Do not mistake a sentry for him. He is the one the ice listens to.

gallery_ready.text: The gallery is quiet enough to try the north stair. That stair is Ysolde. When she falls, tell Kara. I am not leaving this fire to carry the word.

offer_vault.text: Ysolde of the Black Ice, in the vault. End her. The reward Kara promised is at the Hearthpass fire, not here. I can only point at the stair.

vault_active.text: She is at the far end of the vault. The knights near her help each other. She does not need them.

after.text: You have the stair behind you and Kara ahead of you, if the vault is done. I keep the fire. That was the bargain I made with the cold.
